brief:
Israeli occupation forces attacked a Palestinian woman as they raided and searched her home in Beit Amr, a town north of Hebron, the Ma'an news agency reported. The incident occurred during what the military characterized as a routine operation in the area.

Details of the circumstances surrounding the assault and the purpose of the raid were not immediately clear. The report documented the moment of the alleged attack during the home incursion.
title: Israeli forces assault Palestinian woman during home raid in Beit Amr
